meta.name: performance
meta.description: Performance analysis, profiling, and optimization. Use when optimizing slow code, reducing memory, or scaling to larger datasets. Covers profiling, bottleneck identification, and optimization patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位代码瓶颈,让程序跑得更快更省内存。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果代码跑得慢、内存占用高,想找到瓶颈对症下药。
copy.tagline_en: Find performance bottlenecks and make your code faster and leaner.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code is slow or memory-hungry and you need to pinpoint and fix bottlenecks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会先要求对代码做性能剖析，用cProfile等工具定位瓶颈（CPU、I/O、内存、N+1查询等），再给出向量化、缓存、算法改进等优化方案，并验证改前改后的时间与内存变化。
howto.when: 当你提到代码运行慢、处理的数据集变大、接口延迟超时，或内存占用异常增长时触发。它会先运行剖析，再给出优化建议。

say.text: 这段处理百万行的函数很慢，先帮我用cProfile剖析一下。
say.note: Claude会给出剖析命令和瓶颈分析。

say.text: 这个接口平均延迟800ms，帮我定位瓶颈并优化。
say.note: Claude会检查耗时环节并给出优化方案。

say.text: 内存一直涨，帮我查一下是哪部分代码导致的。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will insist on profiling before optimizing, use tools like cProfile to locate bottlenecks (CPU, I/O, memory, N+1 queries), then suggest vectorization, caching, or algorithm changes, and verify before/after time and memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report slow code, larger datasets, API latency over SLO, or unexpected memory growth. It starts by profiling, then recommends optimizations.

say_en.text: This million-row function is slow; profile it with cProfile first.
say_en.note: Gives profiling commands and bottleneck analysis.

say_en.text: This endpoint averages 800ms latency; find the bottleneck and optimize.
say_en.note: Checks where time is spent and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Memory keeps growing; help me find which code causes it.
say_en.note: Uses memory_profiler to locate the cause.
